description.value:
The Quasar is perhaps the most distinctive weapon you can find in Night City. It features an unusual, angular frame, classic disc magazine and one-of-a-kind technology. After all, the Quasar is an electromagnetic gun. The barrel holds four electrically charged shafts, which, in combination with the bullet, form opposing electromagnetic poles. The resulting forces release the bullet – at lightning speed. A shot from the unassuming Quasar can even pierce armored vehicles and bulletproof vests.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 16 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with all Capacity modifying Attachments. While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged, it is only capable of using Autofire. This weapon only expends 8 rounds when using Autofire. If there are not 8 rounds left for Autofire, the entire magazine is expended.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
